hero.name: Dr. Arun Shah
hero.title: Senior Consultant Urologist
bioParagraphs: Dr. Arun Shah is M.Ch in Urology and distinguished urologist working in Janakpur. With a commitment to bringing world-class urological care to Janakpur and the Madhesh Province, he specializes in advanced, minimally invasive laser surgeries and advanced laparoscopic surgeries
His clinical philosophy centers around patient comfort, ethical medical practices, and utilizing the latest technological advancements to ensure faster recovery times and better outcomes.

items.description: Highest tier surgical super-specialization focusing on advanced endourology, reconstructive urology, renal transplantation, and minimally invasive laser surgeries (RIRS, HoLEP, PCNL). Awarded the university first-rank in MCh Urology for academic and surgical excellence.

Comprehensive surgical residency mastery encompassing complex abdominal procedures, trauma management, intensive critical care, and surgical oncology, establishing the rigorous foundation for urological super-specialization.
Fundamental medical and surgical degree with clinical honors, extensive patient diagnostics training, and comprehensive medical science discipline.

items: Laser Kidney Stone Surgery (RIRS, PCNL, URSL))

philosophy.quote: My goal is to provide world-class urological care that is accessible, empathetic, and strictly ethical. I believe in empowering patients through education, ensuring they understand their conditions and treatment options fully before making decisions. Anxiety should be relieved the moment a patient walks into my clinic.
